propositions: Build and test a one-time history-strip operational script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) without new external dependencies.
The script must run only on fresh unfiltered clones and reject blob:none partial clones with a clear error message.
Strip both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and tree identity after dynamic re-add.
Parse fast-export data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages that begin with git command syntax (M, D) without confusion.
Verify that the rewritten branch has identical commit/merge counts, tree identity, and pack size under 150 MB, with source remote refs and the protected tag left unchanged.
The dry-run script must never push and must complete all assertions before emitting final success; A6-1 owns remote publication and tag deletion.
